contentItem.title: 有理线段与无理线段的约定
contentItem.englishTitle: With these hypotheses, it is proved that there exist straight lines infinite in multitude which are commensurable and incommensurable respectively, some in length only, and others in square also, with an assigned straight line. Let then the assigned straight line be called rational, and those straight lines which are commensurable with it, whether in length and in square or in square only, rational, but those which are incommensurable with it irrational.

surfaces.text: With these hypotheses, it is proved that there exist straight lines infinite in multitude which are commensurable and incommensurable respectively, some in length only, and others in square also, with an assigned straight line. Let then the assigned straight line be called rational, and those straight lines which are commensurable with it, whether in length and in square or in square only, rational, but those which are incommensurable with it irrational.
有了这些假设,可以证明存在着无限的直线,其数量分别为可公度和不可公度,有些只是长度,另一些在正方形, 并有指定的直线。 之后,指定的直线称为有理, 与之相连的直线为可公度, 无论是长度为正方形, 或仅正方形, 有理, 但却是不可公度, 无理。
